Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>"
    options = ConversionOptions(compact_tables=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
